purpose_context: After the built-in split, the only recorded digest covers the built-in shell, so doctrine edits in member and org packs are not pinned. This mission records a digest sidecar for every pack, verifies all of them in the required gate, and closes the residual manifest-completeness gap from #182.
purpose_tldr: Every pack in the catalogue carries a recorded tree digest that CI verifies, so no pack content can change unnoticed.
